summary: Tested the default admin account and admin settings (PUT /api/auth/me) through the backend (pytest, 8 of 8 passed, plus a manual restart check) and in the UI with Playwright (all flows passed). The default admin 1234567890/admin123 logs in. /auth/me returns default_password=true, and the banner shows. The settings dialog has all 6 fields, pre-filled. Wrong current password returns 400 and shows a toast. A mismatched confirm shows a toast on the client only. A short new password returns 400 from the API and is blocked by the browser's minLength in the UI. Changing the name and password saves; the banner disappears and the header name updates. After that the old password returns 401 and the new password logs in. Changing the phone works for login, and a phone that belongs to another account returns 400. Students and drivers get 403. After a backend restart the edited admin stayed as edited: it was not reset or recreated. The admin has been restored to 1234567890/admin123, 'مدير النظام', altayyd889@gmail.com, default_password=true. TEST_ accounts were deleted and login_attempts cleared.

minor.issue: The email is not validated on the backend (Optional[str], not EmailStr). Only the browser's type=email check applies.

Any change to new_password sets default_password=False, even if the new password equals ADMIN_PASSWORD. The banner then hides even though the default password is still in use. Changing only the phone or name keeps the banner, which looks intended.

action_items: Optional: use EmailStr (or allow empty) for ProfileIn.email
Optional: set default_password from check_pw(ADMIN_PASSWORD, new_hash) instead of always False
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses a Bearer token stored in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies, and CORS_ORIGINS='*'. This is acceptable for the Bearer design but differs from the playbook's cookie recommendation.
The startup seed is correct: it inserts an admin only when no admin exists and never overwrites password_hash. The backfill only sets default_password when the field is missing.
bcrypt hashes start with $2b$. The lockout is keyed by phone (5 attempts / 15 min).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ student and driver accounts were created temporarily and deleted by id. No data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_settings.py changes the admin and restores it in its teardown (via the API plus Mongo default_password=true). Run it serially (-n 0) so it does not race other suites that log in as the admin.
